context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: まわし/近づき/ウサギ/改札/加熱/旨い/ヤバイ/思いつく

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、コマまわし、ぼく、できるようになったよ!
lines.en: Mom, I learned how to spin a top!
lines.style: Bright, quick opening. Chest-forward delivery — he's bursting to tell her. Lift on the final word. Genuine child pride, no performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。雨雲、だんだん、近づきつつあるね、外、暗くなってきた。
lines.en: Mm-hmm. The rain clouds are moving in, though. It's getting dark outside.
lines.style: Quiet observation, spoken to herself as much as to him. Slow, measured pace. Gaze drifting outward. The voice of someone noticing things, not narrating them.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんち、ウサギ、まだいるかな、会いたいな。
lines.en: I wonder if Grandpa's rabbit is still there. I want to see it.
lines.style: Soft yearning in the opening. Quick, hopeful rise on the question. Small voice — he's thinking out loud, not demanding. The gentleness of a child's quiet wish.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 駅の改札、人、混んでたわね、さっき、行きに。
lines.en: The station gate was packed earlier, when we were heading out.
lines.style: Dry, almost-amused observation. Matter-of-fact delivery. A small rueful sigh underneath. The voice of someone who noticed but wasn't bothered.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お餅、レンジで加熱したら、ふくらんだよ!
lines.en: The mochi puffed up when I microwaved it!
lines.style: Sudden bright spark of discovery. Quick tempo, open vowels. Delight without self-consciousness. The genuine wonder of a small experiment that worked.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんが作ったカレー、めっちゃ旨いよね、翔くんも好きだよね。
lines.en: Dad's curry is really delicious, isn't it? You like it too, Sho.
lines.style: Warm, conversational rhythm. Soft smile in the voice. She's not teaching — she's enjoying the thought of him enjoying it. Gentle affirmation without pressure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 宿題、まだ、ヤバイ、終わってないんだよ、ぼく。
lines.en: My homework still isn't done. I'm in trouble.
lines.style: Slight wince on the opening. Self-aware, rueful tone — he knows he should have done it. Small and a little sheepish, but honest. No drama, just acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いいアイディア、ふと、思いつくこと、あるわよね、翔くん。
lines.en: You come up with good ideas out of nowhere sometimes, don't you, Sho?
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. Gentle rhythm, as if she's noticing something she's seen before but still finds surprising. Warm close — an affirmation he didn't ask for.
